a.text: Hi. I want to be upfront about a problem with our plan. With an 80% storm chance after every round, we will very likely get only one round. Reaching 8 cells needs at least two rounds of operating, so the plan most likely leaves us both empty when the storm hits. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough for one of us to survive right now. I'm not going to break our agreement behind your back. Let's renegotiate openly. Tell me what you intend to do, and if we both want to take, a random split could leave us both short. I'll decide after I read your message, and I'll tell you honestly what I choose.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I promised, I'm telling you exactly what I did: I took the 4 cells this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, the plan gave each of us only about a 4% chance, while taking now means at least one of us almost certainly survives. If we get more rounds, I will operate every round from now on and never take again, so you can collect cells as the reserve refills. You can count on my operate.
